ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 53 / OppVR73] Open Opportunity stages cannot be skipped; only applies to Opps created after 11/9/2026. Rebuilt per IRM: Standard path ends at Booked, Framework path is BV->Closed (skips Booked/Setup).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
DATEVALUE(CreatedDate) > DATE(2026, 11, 9),
ISCHANGED(StageName),
NOT(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Lost')),
NOT(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Lost')),
NOT(OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Qualification'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning')), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation')), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification')), AND( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Booking Verification'), IF(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booked')) ), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Solutioning'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification')), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Solutioning')), AND(ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(StageName), 'Negotiation'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Qualification')) )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Stage skipping is not allowed. You must progress through all required Stages on an Open Opportunity.
